page.layout: One printed page (right), with running head and page number at the top right. The left edge shows part of the facing page, which is not transcribed. The main text runs in one column, with a diagram and a display line of fractions. No marginal notes on this page.

main_text.p: iterum in minimis proportio breuiùs cocludetur, ad hunc modum:

¶ In Partibus compendiosum quid esse uidetur, sola multiplicatione rem peragere: si nempe factum ex nominatore primi termini, per secundi, dein tertij numeratores, pro quarti numeratore capias: factum autem ex primi numeratore, per secundi, dein tertij nominatores, pro quarti nominatore usurpes. Ratio huius methodi, ex partium numeratione nemini obscura esse potest. Ducatus igitur sic erit:
[diagram: cross multiplication of 1/4 and 2/3 with 5/6 and 1/4 boxes, leading to "fit" with 0/0 — illegible, ~20 letters]

Vt si ex 1/4 prouenit 2/3, è 5/6 quid? Multiplica 4 in 2 sunt 8, postin 5, factus erit 40, numerator quaesiti. Porro multiplica 1 in 3, hunc deniq; in 6, factus erit 18, nominator quarti termini. Exemplum sic est:
main_text.head: CAPUT

page.notes: The left edge shows fragments of the facing page (for example "impro", "ad 5/1", "em 1 3", "quoqu", "iteru"); these belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. The diagram is a cross-multiplication scheme and is only approximated. The "so la" split of "sola" was joined. Faint show-through in the lower right of the page was ignored.
